purpose: Teach: 松岡/呉/伊東/藤沢/永井/尾崎/黒田/英寿

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、TOKIOの松岡昌宏さんを尊敬されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really admires Matsuoka Masahiro from TOKIO.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening. Speaking to Aoi as if sharing a small, warm detail noticed in conversation. Unhurried pace, reflective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、広島県の呉のご出身だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer is from Kure, in Hiroshima, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact sharing. Slight warmth underneath—noticing something personal about someone. Soft landing on the place name, like it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、伊豆の伊東温泉のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he told us all about Ito hot springs in Izu.
lines.style: Gentle delight in the memory. Light, conversational pace. Voice brightens slightly on 'hot springs'—the beauty of the detail pleases her. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、藤沢周平先生の時代小説がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's a big fan of Fujisawa Shuhei's historical novels.
lines.style: Soft recognition. Appreciative tone—noticing the depth of his taste. Unhurried, like she's turning the fact over thoughtfully. Slight pause before the author's name, respectful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、永井荷風先生の文学を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He talked to us about Nagai Kafu's literature.
lines.style: Warmth tinged with respect for the gravity of the subject. Even pace, careful with the author's name. Voice settles deeper—this is something that mattered to him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、尾崎豊さんの曲を聴かれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer listens to Ozaki Yutaka's music.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender recognition. Voice rounds the musician's name gently. Pace slows slightly—music is intimate. Quiet certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、野球の黒田博樹投手のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's a fan of Kuroda Hiroki, the baseball pitcher.
lines.style: Light appreciation in the tone. Simple, direct statement but with warmth. Slight lift on 'pitcher'—acknowledging the specificity of the fandom. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サッカーの中田英寿選手のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He told us about Nakada Hidetoshi, the soccer player.
lines.style: Soft, reflective close. Voice settles as if this detail completes a picture. Unhurried, almost reverent. Gentle trailing-off at the end, like a quiet conclusion.
